questions.answer: Convert to base $3$: $(3^3)^{x-1} = (3^2)^{x+2} \Rightarrow 3^{3x-3} = 3^{2x+4}$. Equating exponents: $3x - 3 = 2x + 4 \Rightarrow x = 7$.

questions.q: Simplify the radical expression: $(81 x^8 y^{12})^{1/4}$ for positive $x$ and $y$.
questions.answer: Apply exponent to each factor: $81^{1/4} = 3$, $(x^8)^{1/4} = x^2$, $(y^{12})^{1/4} = y^3$. Result is $3x^2 y^3$.

questions.q: If $2^{x} = 5$, what is the value of $2^{x+3}$?
Condense into a single logarithm: $2\log x + 3\log y - \log z$.
questions.answer: Apply power rule: $\log(x^2) + \log(y^3) - \log z = \log(x^2 y^3) - \log z = \log(\frac{x^2 y^3}{z})$.

questions.q: If $\log_{10}(2) \approx 0.301$, what is the approximate value of $\log_{10}(20)$?

questions.answer: $\log(x(x - 3)) = 1 \Rightarrow x^2 - 3x = 10 \Rightarrow x^2 - 3x - 10 = 0 \Rightarrow (x - 5)(x + 2) = 0$. Since $x > 3$, the only valid solution is $x = 5$.

sections.heading: Section 4: Exponential Growth, Decay & Compound Interest

questions.q: A radioactive isotope decays according to $N(t) = 800(0.5)^{t/12}$, where $t$ is measured in days. How much of the isotope remains after $36$ days?
A principal of $5,000$ is invested at an annual interest rate of $4\%$ compounded quarterly. Which expression represents the balance after $5$ years?
questions.answer: Compound interest formula: $A = P(1 + \frac{r}{n})^{nt}$. Here $n = 4$ and $t = 5$, giving exponent $4 \times 5 = 20$.

questions.q: A population of fish grows by $8\%$ each year. If the initial population is $1,200$, what is the population after $t$ years?
questions.answer: Growth rate is $r = 0.08$. The exponential model is $P(t) = P_0 (1 + r)^t = 1200(1.08)^t$.
